Order No.06 Dated : 14.06.2024
1.

The instant revision petition has been filed against the judgment and order dated 26.09.2022 passed in Cr. Appeal No. 40 of 2022 whereby and whereunder, the appellant has been convicted and sentence under Section 498A of Indian Penal Code for simple imprisonment of six months and has been further directed to make payment of Rs.5000/- as fine.
2. I.A. No. 11025 of 2022 has been filed for exemption from surrender on the ground of merit in the instant revision petition.
The ground, taken, cannot be considered at this stage in view of the concurrent judgment and conviction of sentence.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that as per the prosecution case that there was a specific demand of Rupees Five Lakh as dowry and in pursuant to that demand Rupees Fifty Thousand has been paid.
However, this part of the prosecution case has been disbelieved and the charge under Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act was not proved.
In the absence of proof of unlawful demand, Section 498A of Indian Penal Code will be not made out.
Therefore the offence of cruelty as defined under explanation (b) to Section 498 A will not be made out.

4. It is further argued that as per explanation (a) appended to Section 498A of Indian Penal Code cruelty has been defined to include any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman.

There is no medical evidence to substantiate the allegation of such an injury to have been caused to the victim lady and therefore it will not come under Kranti Gandhi vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41928946/

5.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the interlocutory application for exemption from surrender.
6. Considering the submissions made, the interlocutory application for exemption from surrender before the learned Court below is allowed.
This revision petition is admitted.
Let the case be listed for hearing on 04.07.2024.
In the meantime, call for lower court records from the court concerned.
